topic_ko: 학교 홍보 책자 인쇄 비용 문의 편지
_note: 실용문(편지) — 주제/주장/빈칸 등 학술유형은 제외하고 어법·어휘·순서·삽입·요약·서술형만 작성. grammar/vocab 의 밑줄 어구는 해당 passage 문장에 글자 그대로 존재.

passage: To whom it may concern, I am a teacher at Pendington High School, and we are currently preparing a new school promotional brochure.
As we wish to update the overall design of our brochure, we are considering to work with a new printing company.
While reviewing several options, we felt that your design style and printing formats seemed to suit our needs well.
We intend to make a four-paged brochure and print 500 copies in full color.
Before proceeding, we would like to ask you how much it would cost.
This will greatly help us in setting our budget and schedule more effectively.
Thank you very much for your time and assistance, and I look forward to your response.
Sincerely, Sarah Clayton
grammar.explanation_ko: ② consider 는 to부정사가 아니라 동명사를 목적어로 취하는 동사이다. 따라서 consider to work 가 아니라 consider working 이 되어야 한다. 정답 ②.
grammar.distractor_ko: ①현재진행형 are preparing, ③While (we were) reviewing 의 분사구문, ④전치사 Before + 동명사 proceeding, ⑤look forward to 의 to 는 전치사이므로 뒤에 명사 your response 가 오는 것 모두 옳다.

passage: To whom it may concern, I am a teacher at Pendington High School, and we are currently preparing a new school promotional brochure.
As we wish to update the overall design of our brochure, we are considering working with a new printing company.
While reviewing several options, we felt that your design style and printing formats seemed to suit our needs well.
We intend to make a four-paged brochure and print 500 copies in full color.
Before proceeding, we would like to conceal how much it would cost.
This will greatly help us in setting our budget and schedule more effectively.
Thank you very much for your time and assistance, and I look forward to your response.
Sincerely, Sarah Clayton
vocab.explanation_ko: ④ 편지의 목적은 비용을 '묻는(ask)' 것이며, 그래야 뒤 문장의 '예산과 일정을 세우는 데 도움이 된다'는 흐름이 이어진다. conceal(숨기다)은 정반대 의미라 문맥상 틀리다 → ask 로 고쳐야 한다.
vocab.distractor_ko: ①promotional(홍보용의), ②update(새롭게 하다), ③suit(~에 맞다), ⑤budget(예산)은 모두 문맥에 적절하다.

order.given: To whom it may concern, I am a teacher at Pendington High School, and we are currently preparing a new school promotional brochure.

blocks.A: Before proceeding, we would like to ask you how much it would cost. This will greatly help us in setting our budget and schedule more effectively.
blocks.B: As we wish to update the overall design of our brochure, we are considering working with a new printing company. While reviewing several options, we felt that your design style and printing formats seemed to suit our needs well.
blocks.C: We intend to make a four-paged brochure and print 500 copies in full color.

order.explanation_ko: 책자를 준비 중이라는 소개(주어진 글) 뒤에 (B)에서 왜 새 업체를 찾는지와 이 회사를 고른 이유를 밝히고, (C)에서 인쇄 사양(4쪽·500부·전면 컬러)을 제시한 뒤, (A)에서 비용 문의와 그 이유로 마무리한다. (B)-(C)-(A)가 자연스럽다.
order.distractor_ko: (A)의 비용 문의는 인쇄 사양(C)이 제시된 뒤에야 의미가 있으므로 앞자리에 올 수 없고, (C)의 구체적 사양도 업체를 고른 이유(B)보다 먼저 나올 수 없다.

insert.insert_sentence: While reviewing several options, we felt that your design style and printing formats seemed to suit our needs well.

passage_marked.text: To whom it may concern, I am a teacher at Pendington High School, and we are currently preparing a new school promotional brochure.
As we wish to update the overall design of our brochure, we are considering working with a new printing company.
We intend to make a four-paged brochure and print 500 copies in full color.
Before proceeding, we would like to ask you how much it would cost.
This will greatly help us in setting our budget and schedule more effectively.

insert.explanation_ko: 주어진 문장의 several options 는 '새 인쇄 업체를 알아보는 중'이라는 ②앞 문장을 받고, your design style 로 수신 업체를 특정해 이후의 사양 제시·비용 문의로 이어진다. 따라서 ②가 정답.
insert.distractor_ko: ①에 넣으면 아직 업체를 찾는다는 언급이 없어 several options 가 무엇의 선택지인지 알 수 없고, ③ 이후에 넣으면 이미 사양·비용 이야기가 시작된 뒤라 업체 선정 이유가 뒤늦게 끼어들어 흐름이 끊긴다.

passage: To whom it may concern, I am a teacher at Pendington High School, and we are currently preparing a new school promotional brochure.
As we wish to update the overall design of our brochure, we are considering working with a new printing company.
While reviewing several options, we felt that your design style and printing formats seemed to suit our needs well.
We intend to make a four-paged brochure and print 500 copies in full color.
Before proceeding, we would like to ask you how much it would cost.
This will greatly help us in setting our budget and schedule more effectively.
Thank you very much for your time and assistance.
I look forward to your response.
summary.summary_template: Planning a redesigned school brochure, the writer explains the exact printing __(A)__ and requests a price quote so that the school can plan its budget and schedule more __(B)__.
summary.explanation_ko: 필자는 4쪽·500부·전면 컬러라는 인쇄 (A)사양(specifications)을 밝히고 견적을 요청하며, 그것이 예산과 일정을 더 (B)효율적으로(efficiently) 세우는 데 도움이 된다고 했다. ⑤가 정답.
summary.distractor_ko: (A) 마감 기한(deadline)이나 장소(location)는 언급되지 않았고, (B) 빠르게·창의적으로·저렴하게가 아니라 '더 효과적·효율적으로' 세운다는 것이 본문 내용이다.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 진행하기에 앞서, 비용이 얼마나 들지 여쭤보고 싶습니다.
writing.answer: Before proceeding, we would like to ask you how much it would cost.
writing.explanation_ko: 전치사 Before + 동명사 proceeding, would like to + 동사원형, ask + 목적어(you) + 의문사절(how much it would cost)의 어순.

writing.question: 다음 우리말과 같은 뜻이 되도록 <보기>의 단어를 모두 배열하여 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 저희는 4쪽짜리 책자를 만들어 전면 컬러로 500부를 인쇄할 계획입니다.
writing.answer: We intend to make a four-paged brochure and print 500 copies in full color.
writing.explanation_ko: intend + to부정사, and 뒤에서 반복되는 to 를 생략한 병렬 구조(to make ... and (to) print ...).

writing.question: 다음 우리말을 <조건>에 맞게 영작하시오.
writing.ko_prompt: 저희 책자의 전반적인 디자인을 새롭게 하고자 하므로, 저희는 새로운 인쇄 업체와 협업하는 것을 고려하고 있습니다.
conditions: 이유를 나타내는 접속사 As 로 시작할 것
wish to update 를 사용할 것
writing.answer: As we wish to update the overall design of our brochure, we are considering working with a new printing company.
writing.explanation_ko: 이유의 As + 절, wish to + 동사원형, consider + 동명사(working)의 세 조건을 모두 만족해야 한다.

writing.question: 다음 빈칸에 들어갈 알맞은 한 단어를 본문에서 찾아 쓰시오.
writing.context: This will greatly help us in setting our ___________ and schedule more effectively.
writing.explanation_ko: 비용을 알아야 세울 수 있는 것은 '예산(budget)'이며, 본문 여섯 번째 문장에 그대로 등장한다.

writing.question: 다음 밑줄 친 문장을 우리말로 해석하시오.
writing.en_prompt: While reviewing several options, we felt that your design style and printing formats seemed to suit our needs well.
writing.answer: 여러 선택지를 검토하던 중, 저희는 귀사의 디자인 방식과 인쇄 형식이 저희의 필요에 잘 맞는 것 같다고 느꼈습니다.
writing.explanation_ko: While reviewing 은 분사구문(= While we were reviewing), seem to V 는 '~인 것 같다', suit one's needs 는 '~의 필요에 맞다'.

writing.question: 다음 글을 읽고, 요약문의 빈칸 (A), (B)에 들어갈 단어를 본문에 근거하여 쓰시오.
writing.summary: The writer describes the (A)___________ of the planned brochure and asks the company how much the printing would (B)___________.
writing.explanation_ko: (A) 필자는 책자의 '디자인(design)'을 새롭게 하려 한다고 밝혔고, (B) 편지의 핵심 용건은 인쇄에 비용이 얼마나 '드는지(cost)' 묻는 것이다.
